title: Explainability, Responsibility, and Hardware Acceleration for Digital Health
content: The process of developing a full cycle of artificial intelligence in healthcare applications requires a series of processes in different stages and must have proper standards. This article explains the process of AI develop- ment in three stages. The first stage discusses explainable AI, and how to formulate the problem, select features, and choose a proper AI model. Second, the article explains the steps and specifications of choosing a proper hardware accelerator that fits the selected AI model. Third, discussing responsible AI and how the final product is reliable and properly evaluated for safe AI practice. The article provides a survey of the state of the art in current issues and applications of various AI models, along with the associated development processes. The article aims to give the reader a better understanding of the full AI cycle and development process.
